title: Gabi a Girl in Pieces by Isabel Quintero
description:
Novels and Nibbles has chosen beautifully real, laugh-out-loud, and heartwarming coming-of-age story about family, culture, and self-acceptance that you won't be able to put down.

 Written in a witty, painfully honest diary format, the book follows Mexican-American teenager, Gabi Hernandez, as she navigates the ultimate rollercoaster of her high school senior year. Between handling her father’s addiction, supporting her best friends through major life changes, dealing with body image pressures, and satisfying her ultimate cravings for Pepe's hot wings, Gabi uses poetry to find her voice and figure out who she truly is.

Now let’s dive into her “ultimate craving” Small style…Hot Wings that are crispy oven roasted chicken wings seasoned with our super secret, special spice blend and tossed in house-made buffalo sauce and served with our own creamy kitchen creation of ranch.

Don’t forget the beer…Hot wings and cold beer: the ultimate dynamic duo of spice and ice. We hope to see you for this one for sure.

Half Dozen = $12.95/ Dozen = $18.95
